content:
**Cranberry Relish** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A jar of relish made by cooking a mixture of cranberries, gourds, and sugar. It greatly reduces hunger restores a moderate amount of HP and AP while giving a large bonus to XP earned.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Cranberries (2) Gourd (2) Sugar (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Cranberry Relish | | Cranberry Relish (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after learning the Recipe.
- Has a 12.2% chance to be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.

- It is tied with Tasty Squirrel Stew in giving the highest XP bonus effect of all food items, with a base 10% increase on any experience gained for one hour.
- This item is positively affected by the Herbivore mutation, doubling its experience gain effect from 10% to 20%, which can be further increased with the Strange In Numbers perk to a total of 25% bonus XP gain from one food buff alone.
- With many of its ingredients readily available at specific locations, cranberry relish is relatively easier to stock up on when compared to its carnivore-based counterpart.
